WITH race_name_stats AS (
  SELECT
    r.name,
    AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) AS driver_count
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(driver_count) AS avg_driver_count
  FROM race_name_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(rns.avg_points),
  AVG(rns.driver_count),
  AVG(rns.driver_count - o.avg_driver_count)
FROM race_name_stats AS rns
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE rns.driver_count > o.avg_driver_count;
